run_relaxation_calculations: run atomic structure relaxation calculations on a sequence of molecules using an ASE calculator
create_relaxation_runner: create a RelaxationRunner instance with a calculator and input data to relax atomic structures
save_relaxation_checkpoint: save the current relaxation progress to a checkpoint file for resuming interrupted calculations
load_relaxation_checkpoint: load a previously saved relaxation checkpoint to resume calculations from the last completed structure
write_relaxation_results: write relaxation calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the specified results directory
